preregistration: Latent birth verification — z0 = G0, z1 = O1
status: FROZEN — declared before the O1 four-gate verdict existed
scope: verification only; the birth IMPLEMENTATION is not specified here (see not_frozen_here)

state_at_freeze.why_this_matters: Freezing after the O1 verdict would make the birth criteria a function of O1's numbers — the exact failure mode the C1 preregistration was built to prevent.

what_is_being_tested.question: When two complementary policies are compressed into one latent-conditioned network, does the complementarity survive being forced through z?

prior_failures_this_guards_against.v6i26: distinct z indices with indistinguishable behavior

eligibility.requires: O1 protocol returns RETAINED on all four gates
eligibility.if_o1_fails: this protocol stays dormant; it is not adapted, reused at a lower bar, or applied to a different candidate

source_pairing.rule: index-matched, identical to O1 gates 1-3; no cross-seed rematching, no selecting the best combination

latent_mapping.relabeling_after_evaluation: PROHIBITED — swapped branches are a result, not a labelling error

latent_execution.note: K=4 exists in the architecture; nothing here obliges the science to fill it

evaluation_seeds.collision_policy: FAIL CLOSED — abort rather than proceed if any evaluation seed appears in a prior block

populations_and_metrics: identical to the corresponding frozen O1 gates; only the seeds are new

preservation_rule.name: 75% preservation
preservation_rule.pre_birth_source: the value measured by run_o1_gates.py for the SAME index-matched pair
preservation_rule.defined_only_when: the pre-birth quantity is positive; if it is zero or negative that pair did not pass the corresponding O1 gate and birth was not eligible
preservation_rule.status: SECONDARY — every gate also requires the post-birth measurement to independently satisfy the original O1 pass criterion
preservation_rule.rationale: Compression of two independently trained networks into one latent-conditioned network is expected to cost something. This says prospectively how much is tolerable, so a strong crossover cannot be accepted as a ghost of itself.

birth_gate_1_c1_crossover_survives.base_criterion: delta >= 0.10 AND 95% CI excludes 0 (same as O1 gate 1)
birth_gate_1_c1_crossover_survives.retention: pre = O1 gate 1 delta for this pair; post = P(preserve|z1) - P(preserve|z0); require >= 0.75

birth_gate_2_anchor_crossover_survives.population: natural episodes where C1 never fires, seeds 9710000-9710029
birth_gate_2_anchor_crossover_survives.compare: forced z0 vs forced z1, full-episode
birth_gate_2_anchor_crossover_survives.retention: pre = ( WR(G0) + 0.05 ) - WR(O1) from O1 gate 2; post = the same quantity under forced z; require >= 0.75

birth_gate_3_repertoire_value_survives.compare: oracle selector(z0,z1) vs best fixed forced-z branch
birth_gate_3_repertoire_value_survives.selector: within-episode, one-way, switches to z1 at first C1 onset — identical construction to O1 gate 3
birth_gate_3_repertoire_value_survives.base_criterion: gain >= 0.05 AND 95% CI excludes 0, gain positive (same as O1 gate 3)
birth_gate_3_repertoire_value_survives.retention: pre = O1 gate 3 gain for this pair; require >= 0.75

families.Z0: forced-z0 outputs of B1, B2, B3
families.Z1: forced-z1 outputs of B1, B2, B3

measurement_a.measures: divergence of action distributions at matched observations

measurement_b.at_K2: exactly one pair, so the mean is the single z0-z1 distance

absolute_distinction_bands.why_three_bands: 'collapsed' and 'not distinct enough' are different findings. A result of e.g. 0.24 means the branches differ somewhat but did not reach the preregistered threshold — reporting that as collapse would overstate the failure.

threshold_provenance.primary_source: rl.forced_z_behavior_vectors.DEFAULT_BEHAVIOR_PAIR_THRESHOLD — the repository's canonical bar for this exact metric
threshold_provenance.why_primary: The claim this protocol supports is a strong one. Using a threshold softer than the project already ships for the same measurement would leave an unnecessary hole in it.
threshold_provenance.historical_floor_source: V6I22E's birth gate, which scored 0.033 and failed
threshold_provenance.historical_floor_role: classification of severe collapse ONLY; NOT sufficient for LATENT_BIRTH_PASS
threshold_provenance.superseded_note: An earlier draft of this protocol proposed 0.060 as the pass threshold. It was corrected to 0.35 before the O1 verdict existed and before any birth model was built.
threshold_provenance.may_not_move_because: a latent network 'had to compress two policies' — that is the thing being measured

gate_4_failure_definition.note: Distinct latent IDs alone do not count as distinct strategies.

failure_interpretation.gate_1: the C1 specialist behavior was not preserved through z
failure_interpretation.gate_2: the anchor / crossover structure was lost
failure_interpretation.gate_3: the two branches no longer provide repertoire value
failure_interpretation.gate_4: behavior collapsed, even though the z indices differ

verdict.only_pass_supports: z0 and z1 represent two behaviorally distinct, complementary latent team strategies

not_frozen_here.the_birth_implementation: distillation objective, architecture, optimizer, step budget, how G0 and O1 weights enter the latent network
not_frozen_here.why: it does not exist yet and pretending otherwise would be dishonest
not_frozen_here.requirement: its own manifest, frozen immediately before any birth training begins, WITHOUT reference to birth-evaluation results
not_frozen_here.invariant: the verification protocol above is fixed from today and does not move to accommodate whatever implementation is chosen

after_o1_results_visible_none_of_these_m: any threshold, including the 0.75 retention rule, the 0.35 distinction bar, and the 0.060 severe-collapse classification floor
the z0 = G0, z1 = O1 mapping
the >= 2/3 pair requirement, or the family-level scope of gate 4
immutability.a_failed_birth: may motivate a new birth METHOD, which requires its own preregistration and fresh evaluation seeds and inherits nothing from this one

freeze_record: the commit introducing this file together with docs/latent-birth-preregistration.md; that commit contains no executable changes
